title: 'Tel Aviv Will VANISH, If US…': Iran's ALARMING Message To Trump After New Strike Plan 'Unearthed'
text: ‘Tel Aviv Will VANISH, If US…’: Iran’s ALARMING Message To Trump After New Strike Plan ‘Unearthed’The Middle East stands on the edge of a blade as Iran issues its starkest warning yet. Tehran says any U.S. attack, at any level, would mark the beginning of all-out war. Senior officials reject the idea of a limited strike, vowing an immediate, comprehensive, and unprecedented response aimed at the heart of Tel Aviv.
